samples.summary: PPTX export does not adopt the PR's "'' means unset" convention, so legacy cleared colors serialize as `<a:srgbClr val=""/>`
samples.evidence: The plan (docs/tasks/active/20260812-docs-font-color-reset-todo.md, Non-goals) explicitly declines a migration: documents keep `color: ""` forever and every consumer is expected to treat it as unset. This delta pushed that convention through the canvas painters (paint-layout, table-renderer, resolveColorAtPosition) and through DOCX (where `defaultColorResolver('')` is falsy so the element is skipped), but the PPTX run/marker serializers guard with `!= null` only: `if (s.color != null) children.push('<a:solidFill>' + colorChildXml(storedColorToThemeColor(s.color)) + '</a:solidFill>')` (text.ts:263-266), and likewise `marker.color != null` (line 134), `s.backgroundColor != null` (270), `s.underlineColor != null` (277). A stored `''` therefore reaches `colorChildXml`, which emits `<a:srgbClr val=""/>` — an invalid OOXML color attribute — for exactly the decks this PR says will keep carrying `''`. Since slides reuses the docs rich-text model, this is the same issue-#728 surface the delta chose to fix everywhere else and is the one paint/serialize path left inconsistent.

samples.summary: XML-escaping of `w:color` / `w:shd` fill is unrelated hardening, outside the issue's outcome and acceptance criteria
samples.evidence: The issue's acceptance criterion is purely about the editor render after a color reset ("the text is uncolored (default ink), not the selection color"). Escaping already-resolved color values in the DOCX exporter (plus two new tests) is defensive hardening on a different subsystem; its stated justification (`''` can reach here) is exactly the case that is skipped by the `if (colorHex)` guard, so nothing about the #728 fix requires it. Not blocking, but it widens the PR's blast radius beyond the stated scope.

samples.evidence: `resolveStoredColor` establishes a semantic rule for the shared `StoredColor` data model consumed by docs, slides and the exporters (normalize `''` on both sides of any ColorResolver). No design doc under docs/design/ states this: grepping for `StoredColor` / `ColorResolver` / `defaultColorResolver` across docs/design returns only slides-font-ooxml-parity.md:197, shared-core-extraction.md:43 and docs-named-styles.md:163, none of which define the resolver contract. Per CONTRIBUTING's design-doc discipline this data-model convention would ideally be folded into the canonical docs subsystem doc (docs/design/docs/docs.md) rather than living in a helper's JSDoc, so future callers (e.g. PPTX export) do not miss it.

finding.summary: Renderer guard for legacy `color: ''` is missing in the table text path, so the issue's symptom persists for text inside tables
finding.evidence:
The task doc promises "Renderer treats a falsy resolved color as unset, so documents already saved with `color: ""` … render with the theme default instead of a stale `fillStyle`" and enumerates paintRun / renderListMarker / resolveColorAtPosition. But table cell text is painted by a separate path that still uses `??`:
packages/docs/src/view/table-renderer.ts:457 `const runTextColor = defaultColorResolver(style.color) ?? Theme.defaultColor;`
packages/docs/src/view/table-renderer.ts:564 `ctx.fillStyle = defaultColorResolver(cellBlock.inlines[0]?.style.color) ?? Theme.defaultColor;`
With a stored empty string these assign `''`, which the canvas ignores — exactly the failure mode of #728 (the previous pass is the selection/backgrounds fill). Acceptance criterion "reset the text color → the text is uncolored" therefore still fails for already-saved docs whose colored text lives in a table.

verdict.reason: The finding asserts the table text path lacks the legacy `color: ''` guard, quoting `defaultColorResolver(style.color) ?? Theme.defaultColor` at table-renderer.ts:457 and :564. Those lines do not exist in that form. The cell-text run pass at packages/docs/src/view/table-renderer.ts:463-465 uses `resolveStoredColor(defaultColorResolver, style.color) ?? Theme.defaultColor` (preceded by a 457-462 comment explicitly citing issue #728 and explaining that table cell text bypasses renderRun so it needs its own guard), and the same value is reused for underline (496) and strikethrough (507). The cell list-marker pass at :571-574 does the same with the comment "Same '' guard as the cell-text pass above (issue #728)". packages/docs/src/model/color.ts:45-50 shows `resolveStoredColor` collapses `''` to undefined before the resolver and coerces a falsy result to undefined after (`resolve(c === '' ? undefined : c) || undefined`), so `ctx.fillStyle` is never assigned `''` and the theme default fallback applies. A grep of every `fillStyle`/`style.color` occurrence in table-renderer.ts finds only two text-painting assignments (465, 572), both guarded; the others (177, 226, 442) are cell/inline backgrounds and the selection fill. One counterexample suffices for an absence claim, and there are two.
